-- ============================================================
-- test-14-control_pos.fh  –  Kontrollfluss PASS-Tests
--   (CTL-01..04, WHL-01..03, CAS-01..02, RET-01..04, CHK-01..03)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Control.Pos

import Test.Support exposing NotFound, InvalidInput, Overflow

-- CTL-01: if … then … end if
function abs_val(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= -1000
ensures result >= 0
is
    let r: Integer = n
    if n < 0 then
        r := 0 - n
    end if
    return r
end abs_val

-- CTL-02: if … then … else … end if
function max_of(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
ensures result >= a, result >= b
is
    if a >= b then
        return a
    else
        return b
    end if
end max_of

-- CTL-02: verschachtelte if-else
function classify(n: Integer) returns String
requires n >= 0
is
    if n = 0 then
        return "zero"
    else
        if n < 10 then
            return "small"
        else
            return "large"
        end if
    end if
end classify

-- CTL-04: abort im if-Zweig
function require_pos(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
aborts InvalidInput
ensures result > 0
is
    if n = 0 then
        abort InvalidInput
    end if
    return n
end require_pos

-- WHL-01/02: while mit mehreren invariants
function sum_to(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let total: Integer = 0
    let i: Integer = 0
    while i <= n
    invariant total >= 0
    invariant i >= 0
    variant n - i
    do
        total := total + i
        i := i + 1
    end while
    return total
end sum_to

-- WHL-03: variant als Terminierungsmaß
function count_down(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
ensures result = 0
is
    let c: Integer = n
    while c > 0
    invariant c >= 0
    invariant c <= n
    variant c
    do
        c := c - 1
    end while
    return c
end count_down

-- CAS-01/02: case mit when und default
function day_name(d: Integer) returns String
requires d >= 1, d <= 7
is
    case d is
        when 1 => return "Montag"
        when 2 => return "Dienstag"
        when 3 => return "Mittwoch"
        when 4 => return "Donnerstag"
        when 5 => return "Freitag"
        when 6 => return "Samstag"
        when 7 => return "Sonntag"
        default => return "Unbekannt"
    end case
end day_name

-- RET-01/02/03/04: alle return-Formen
function ret_ok(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
aborts NotFound
ensures success, value >= 0
is
    if n = 0 then
        return error NotFound
    end if
    return ok n
end ret_ok

-- CHK-01: check als Runtime-Assertion
function checked_add(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
ensures result >= a
is
    let total: Integer = a + b
    check total >= a
    check total >= b
    return total
end checked_add

-- CHK-03: check true (immer erfüllt)
function check_always_true() returns Integer
is
    check true
    return 1
end check_always_true

end Test.Control.Pos
